text: After the plate, Detective Okafor starts calling. A lot.
Lina. Got another one. Red jacket, bus stop, last spring. Ring any bells?
Bus forty two. He got off at Maple Street. He was holding a yellow umbrella.
A stolen bike. A missing dog. A face in a crowd from four years ago.
Kid, you're better than every camera in this city.
The police start calling you their search engine.
And for the first time, your memory feels like a superpower.
A day that was stolen. A locked door that knocks back.
And a girl who never forgets... trying to remember.
